title: A Mixed-Method Empirical Study of LLM Assistance in Software Engineering Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2609.04214v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into software development workflows, yet their effects are often discussed without distinguishing between task types, developer seniority, and verification demands. This paper presents a mixed-method empirical study of LLM-assisted software engineering with first-year and fourth-year undergraduates. Phase 1 is a preliminary survey (n=157) that characterizes LLM exposure, reliance, and trust calibration among the two groups. Phase 2 is a task-based quasi-experiment with a purposive sample from both cohorts (n=20). Here, we compare AI-assisted and non-AI conditions on a structured set of software engineering tasks spanning implementation, constraint-driven algorithm selection, and architectural reasoning. translated_title: 软件工程工作流中大语言模型辅助的混合方法实证研究
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正日益融入软件开发工作流，但对其效果的讨论往往未能区分任务类型、开发者资历和验证需求。本文针对一年级和四年级本科生开展了一项关于LLM辅助软件工程的混合方法实证研究。第一阶段是一项初步问卷调查（n=157），刻画了两组学生在LLM接触程度、依赖程度和信任校准方面的特征。第二阶段是一项基于任务的准实验，从两个群体中有目的地抽样（n=20）。在此阶段，我们在一套结构化的软件工程任务集上比较AI辅助与非AI条件，任务涵盖代码实现、约束驱动的算法选择以及架构推理。随后，我们结合通过屏幕录制和定性编码过程捕获的行为痕迹来分析绩效结果。调查结果表明LLM已被广泛采用，并且……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过问卷调查与任务准实验相结合的混合方法，区分任务类型、开发者年级与验证需求三个维度，实证揭示了大语言模型辅助对不同资历开发者软件工程绩效与行为的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a mixed-method empirical study combining a preliminary survey (n=157) and a task-based quasi-experiment (n=20) to reveal how LLM assistance affects software engineering performance and behavior across task types, developer seniority, and verification demands.
